title: Optimising Trotter-Suzuki Simulations of Markovian Open Quantum Systems via Classical Search
summary: Simulating an open quantum system on a digital quantum computer often involves the use of Trotter-Suzuki (TS) Product Formulas (PF) to approximate the system's time evolution. Precise estimates for the required number of Trotter steps (and hence the overall gate count) can be crucial for minimising the computational cost of these methods. Building on established theoretical guarantees, we derive analytic bounds for the First- and Second-Order Deterministic and Randomised TS-PF, directly relating the number of Trotter steps to the model parameters, evolution time and precision.
